resolved: Original source frames, Drive IDs, complete video hashes and original PTS are bound to actually rendered pixels.
Real video engine chroma extraction; uniform measured source camera scale; alpha masks only subtract pixels.
Logical canvas widened without shrinking extended limbs; air sash registration stabilizes torso while legs unfold.
Real hunched Idle visual height corrected to 158 native pixels; upright anatomy is a separate measurement.
CharacterPack transactional staging now copies and verifies external source references.
Runtime atlas source binding cannot be disguised by video references.
Cached crop-context SR matches full model on visible pixels; exact native-derived alpha retained.
LIGHT_JAB and LAND intervals corrected without changing combat counts, duration or impact windows.

sourceBlockers.HIT_STAND: Candidate source main frame 16 is neutral after alpha cleanup; subsequent frames tumble into knockdown. Complete grounded flinch/recovery not found.
sourceBlockers.HIT_CROUCH: Real reaction raises torso above mandatory crouch height tolerance; cannot shrink head/body to hide this.
sourceBlockers.CROUCH_HEAVY: Source rises into chest-up roar/recoil rather than a recognizable striking limb; still unapproved.
sourceBlockers.CROUCH_MEDIUM: Impact candidate leg swings away from opponent; dust intersects body and support-root tracking follows moving foot.
sourceBlockers.THROW_GRAB: Dark embedded opponent overlaps character, including grab hand. Subtractive masking cannot reconstruct occluded limbs.
sourceBlockers.THROW_TOSS: Existing candidate peak is bite; actual release occurs later. No distinct toss verified.
sourceBlockers.JUMP_HEAVY: Existing candidate impact is still overhead windup; actual downward stroke must be selected at preserved impact index.
